tracked_tree_census.classification_rule: Classify first by exact tracked path family (not extension): src/tests/scripts/fixtures/schemas; docs/archive/_graveyard; docs/archive; docs/fixtures; docs/handoff/GENERATED; docs/handoff; remaining docs; prototypes|mission_console|workspace; work|memory|knowledge-src|atlas-experiments|forks; config; root/control. Use extension only as a second-level signal, never to infer ownership.
residual_ambiguous_path_families: docs/canon/schemas/**: YAML lives under docs but is a machine schema contract; whether it should receive a documentation index entry is a policy decision.
docs/fixtures/**: payloads include JSON, Markdown and text; the name and runtime/test usage indicate fixtures, but the auditor currently treats allowed suffixes as docs.
docs/knowledge/**/*.json and docs/handoff/**: data/snapshots can be human-readable evidence, not necessarily current documentation.
docs/archive/_graveyard/**: mixed historical prose, archived authored source, package manifests, one third-party binary and generated result artifacts; path lifecycle is decisive rather than suffix.

explicit_contract.claim: It declares every document under docs/ with type/status/verified; reports a tree document without index entry, an orphaned entry, and stale vigente verification. It explicitly excludes docs/inbox, self_audit_*, root audit_complete_latest.json, __pycache__, and suffixes outside .md/.yaml/.yml/.json/.txt/.html/.bib/.bbl/.py. Audits under docs/audits remain indexable.

implicit_scope_contract.claim: scan_tree uses Path.rglob over the physical docs directory, not git-tracked paths, then filters only by path exceptions and suffix. Its scan is reused by the index writer, docs triage and docs graph. Tests establish inbox/root-runtime-snapshot/handoff behavior but do not test node_modules, vendor, dist/build, fixtures, schemas, archived source trees or ignored/untracked files.

read_only_reproduction.note: No --write action was run. This command observes the present filesystem by implementation design; the classification below independently constrains the population to the sealed tracked tree where relevant.
